item.title: Why Nigerian companies are choosing Kenya for their next move
item.dc:creator: Adonijah Ndege
item.description: Dangote found a pipeline that can carry fuel to customers beyond Kenya. Moniepoint bought a bank that already lends to small businesses. Across energy, banking and capital markets, Nigerian companies are buying in Kenya what would take years to build from scratch.

item.title: Amini wants to turn Africa’s paper archives into data for AI
item.dc:creator: John Adoyi
item.description: Amini, a startup building sovereign AI infrastructure, has released Soma-1X Lite, an open-weight AI model designed to convert paper-based records into machine-readable data.

item.title: Wave’s 25 million-user blueprint: How low fees disrupted Francophone West Africa’s mobile money ‘cartels’
item.dc:creator: Godfrey George
item.description: Wave's Public Policy Lead tells TechCabal how the company forced down prices across the WAEMU region and details the structural and regulatory hurdles that still prevent informal businesses and women from participating fully in the digital economy.

item.description: After more than three decades in a career, what keeps someone going? Is it the money, the excitement of the work, or the desire to see what else they can achieve?
